outcome_evidence: In right_shoulder_cam, the robot approaches the corn during frames 17–34 and closes its fingers around one end during frames 35–40, changing the corn’s orientation. Frames 41–49 do not show a clear lift free of the tabletop; the corn’s lower end remains at the table surface. Completion is therefore unconfirmed, rather than a visibly established failed acquisition: the robot does not withdraw empty or visibly drop the corn. No local failure or unintended side effect is established.
